hero.headline:

From code to production.
hero.subheadline: Java, Spring Boot and AWS for payments, fintech and distributed systems.
hero.supportingText: I'm Bruno. I bring 8+ years of backend engineering across banking and fintech, with hands-on technical leadership from architecture decisions to production troubleshooting.
hero.availability: Open to senior backend and Tech Lead opportunities in Canada.

recruiterSignals.title: Payment integrations
recruiterSignals.body: Java and Spring Boot services connecting banking, card and crypto providers. Clear contracts, explicit transaction states and careful handling of asynchronous callbacks.

recruiterSignals.title: Cloud modernization
recruiterSignals.body: Moving established systems toward AWS and container-based delivery, with attention to migration sequencing, CI/CD and operational continuity.

recruiterSignals.title: Technical direction
recruiterSignals.body: Architecture reviews, ownership boundaries and delivery planning. I stay close to implementation and help teams resolve risk before it becomes expensive.

intro: My career started at Itau Unibanco, working on risk and regulatory systems. In banking, the quality of a change includes whether someone can explain it, trace it and safely recover from it. That has stayed with me.

I moved into fintech to work closer to products and external integrations. At PROFIT Business Bank and Cloud Payments, I built financial reporting services and Java APIs connecting banking, crypto and card providers.

As a Tech Lead, I still work through implementation details. I also help teams decide where responsibilities belong, which failure cases matter, and how to deliver changes without making the next release harder.

philosophy.title: Make state explicit
philosophy.body: A timeout is not a declined payment. I prefer clear state transitions, stable identifiers and enough history to reconstruct what actually happened.

philosophy.title: Keep boundaries useful
philosophy.body: A service boundary should clarify ownership and change. I challenge abstractions that add coordination without making the system easier to maintain.

philosophy.title: Design the recovery path
philosophy.body: Retries, reconciliation and operational visibility belong in the design discussion. Recovery should be a procedure the team understands.

strengths.title: Financial systems
strengths.body: Payment integrations, data consistency, transaction lifecycle design and regulated banking workflows.

strengths.title: Cloud delivery
strengths.body: AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, infrastructure as code and the practical work of modernizing established services.

strengths.title: Team execution
strengths.body: Design reviews, mentoring, technical escalation and translating business needs into a manageable delivery plan.

leadership: I like design reviews that end with a decision, a reason and a clear owner. Written trade-offs make it easier for engineers to move independently.
When an integration fails, I follow the request across boundaries and work back from evidence. The fix should improve the team's understanding of the system, too.
I work with engineering, product and external partners to make the constraints explicit. That makes delivery plans more useful and surprises less frequent.

intro: From risk and regulatory systems in Brazilian banking to payment integrations and technical leadership in fintech.

roles.title: Software Engineering Tech Lead

Work through technical escalations with engineers and external partners, bringing implementation findings back into the design.
